In order to edit an `orgUnitPath`, either update the name of the organization or the `parentOrgunitPath`. A user's organizational unit determines which Google Workspace services the user has access to. If the user is moved to a new organization, the user's access changes. For more information about organization structures, see the [administration help center](https://support.google.com/a/answer/4352075).
